verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party feature in Teams for setting up autonomous background automations, such as scheduled workflows, triggers, or background agents. What it does show are developer building blocks: Graph APIs, bots, and incoming/outgoing webhooks that developers can use to build external services that automate Teams scenarios. These are primitives for constructing automation, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
